[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Maglenna Pendower''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a lesser aide at consulate [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. 

==Biography==
Maglenna was a native of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and lost her father and one of her brothers when it was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]]. She was unable to find out if her other brother was off-planet and was unable to locate him, despite extensive searching.<ref name="SpecOps" />

Her status as an aide allowed her to interact with the staff of other senatorial staff, and enabled her to get information on the true activities of other government officials. While she longed to be active in the field, she was more valuable to Leia as a front to deflect attention, feed false information and cover other's tracks while they were gone.<ref name="SpecOps" />

One day, when Leia was busy preparing [[Imperial Senate/Legends|senatorial]] datawork, the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Master Gardener]] [[Spero]] insisted to see the Princess, even though she had been instructed not to disturb her. She ushered the Ho'Din inside, and then, on Organa's instructions, took him to [[Hindred]] to arrange a safe house for the Master Gardener.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref>{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> 

She enrolled in the Alliance combat medical training program with hopes of finally received a field assignment. Even though she graduated at the top of her class, Leia determined Maglenna was too valuable to risk in combat and had her transferred to [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply Command]].<ref name="SpecOps" />

She was working under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Arik Stijhl]] on [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] at [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]]. While reviewing supplies with the crew of [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']], she was present when the technician [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]] was injured by the [[Doom Slayer]] assassin droid. She applied a defib strip and a pressure resuscitator to revive Morgan. After the assassin droid started its attack on the warehouse, she helped evacuate the drop point, and assisted [[Ivhin Jayme]] in destroying the droid. After everyone was successfully evacuated, she was transferred to [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] at [[T'Charek Haathi]]'s request.<ref name="SpecOps" />
